b: Duluth Trading and WD-40 have launched limited edition collaborative products – Duluth gear with a WD-40 theme.
The Duluth Trading WD-40 collection includes t-shirts, hoodie sweatshirt, fleece robe, tool bag classic ball cap, winter hat, and a Can Commander.
Our friends at the PR firm who worked the launch sent over the Duluth Trading fleece robe and tool bag for me to check out.
I have to say – I’m impressed with Duluth Trading’s quality. I’ve heard great things, but wasn’t quite prepared for what they sent. Both items exceeded my expectations.
Secondly, it’s a fun product line. I haven’t stopped giggling about the giant WD-40 aesthetics. High quality plus lots of joy.
There are no downsides here, no “gotchas” that I can see. It’s just a nice product launch.
Not a fan of the designs? Duluth has others.
These are limited editions. If you’re interested, move quickly.
